component.name: RowListItem
component.script:
sub init() m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.focusIndicator = m.top.findNode("focusIndicator") m.resumeLabel = m.top.findNode("resumeLabel") m.cwBadge = m.top.findNode("cwBadge") m.cwBadgeLabel = m.top.findNode("cwBadgeLabel") m.resumeText = ""
' RowListItem components can receive focusPercent updates from RowList m.top.observeField("focusPercent", "onFocusPercentChanged")
m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onContentSet") onContentSet() end sub
sub onFocusPercentChanged() ' focusPercent is 0..1, fade in focus indicator as a subtle highlight fp = m.top.focusPercent if fp = invalid then fp = 0 m.focusIndicator.opacity = fp if m.resumeLabel <> invalid then m.resumeLabel.visible = (m.resumeText <> "" and fp > 0) end if end sub
sub onContentSet() content = m.top.itemContent poster = "" resumeText = "" if content <> invalid then if content.title <> invalid then m.title.text = content.title else m.title.text = "Unknown" end if
if content.resumePosition <> invalid then resumeText = "Resume at " + formatTime(content.resumePosition) end if
if content.HDPosterUrl <> invalid and content.HDPosterUrl <> "" then poster = content.HDPosterUrl else if content.SDPosterUrl <> invalid and content.SDPosterUrl <> "" then poster = content.SDPosterUrl else if content.hdPosterUrl <> invalid and content.hdPosterUrl <> "" then poster = content.hdPosterUrl else if content.sdPosterUrl <> invalid and content.sdPosterUrl <> "" then poster = content.sdPosterUrl end if else m.title.text = "Unknown" end if
if poster = "" then poster = "pkg:/images/icon_side_hd.png" m.poster.uri = poster if m.resumeLabel <> invalid then m.resumeLabel.text = resumeText m.resumeText = resumeText fp = m.top.focusPercent if fp = invalid then fp = 0 m.resumeLabel.visible = (resumeText <> "" and fp > 0) end if
if m.cwBadge <> invalid then showBadge = false if content <> invalid and content.resumePosition <> invalid and content.resumePosition > 0 then showBadge = true end if m.cwBadge.visible = showBadge end if end sub
function formatTime(seconds as Integer) as String if seconds < 0 then seconds = 0 mins = seconds \ 60 hrs = mins \ 60 mins = mins mod 60 secs = seconds mod 60 if hrs > 0 then return hrs.toStr() + ":" + pad2(mins) + ":" + pad2(secs) end if return mins.toStr() + ":" + pad2(secs) end function
function pad2(n as Integer) as String if n < 10 then return "0" + n.toStr() return n.toStr() end function
